messages:
Anya: quick async check — onboarding a new model (mosaic3b-repro). validator failed on the config.json when trying to point tokenizer to the shared vocab. can someone confirm what fields we expect now for tokenizer and weights URIs?
Anya: payload we used: 
```json
{
  "model": "mosaic3b-repro",
  "weights_uri": "gcs://redwood-models/mosaic3b/v1/weights-00001.tar",
  "tokenizer": {
    "path": "tokenizer/vocab.json",
    "special_tokens": { "bos": 1, "eos": 2 }
  }
}
```
Anya: validator returns unknown-field errors for `tokenizer.path` and complains weights must be under `weights_manifest` for sharded models.
Mike: :eyes: we switched to `tokenizer.uri` last quarter to force absolute URIs (gcs/s3). relative paths are ambiguous in Dedicated/on-prem.
Julian: CI output: `config-lint v0.9.8: error at tokenizer.path: relative path not allowed. hint: use tokenizer.uri or add tokenizer.base_uri`. also `warning: weights_uri deprecated, prefer weights_manifest`
config-bot: config-lint v0.9.8 run by julian — 2 issues: tokenizer.path (ERR), weights_uri (WARN). docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/onboarding#config-fields
Dave: Proposed quick fix: update onboarding script to rewrite old fields -> new fields during validation (compat layer). e.g. if `weights_uri` present AND model_sharded true -> build `weights_manifest` with single entry. similarly map `tokenizer.path` -> `tokenizer.uri` using `base_uri` if provided.
Mike: agree. small followups: 1) add validator rule to allow legacy mapping for 3 months, 2) add an explicit error message telling engineers how to migrate, 3) add test case in config-schema CI.
Anya: does anyone object if I open a tiny PR to the onboarding helper that performs the mapping and bumps config-lint message to be more actionable? I can include example migration snippet.
Julian: please do. include this example in the PR description: 
```json
// migration example in onboarding helper
if (config.tokenizer.path) {
  config.tokenizer.uri = join(config.tokenizer.base_uri || config.model_base_uri || "", config.tokenizer.path)
  delete config.tokenizer.path
}
if (config.weights_uri && config.model_sharded) {
  config.weights_manifest = [{ "uri": config.weights_uri, "shard_index": 0 }]
  delete config.weights_uri
}
```
Julian: also pinged infra to ensure gcs prefixes are allowed in Private installs — they should be, but some envs require `gcs://` -> `gs://` canonicalization.
Anya: cool — I'll open PR after lunch. linking draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/onboard/pull/1892 (WIP). reviewers: @mike, @julian.
Mike: add a tiny unit test that runs `onboard/validate --example legacy-config.json` and expects the transformed config to contain `tokenizer.uri` and `weights_manifest`.
config-bot: note: rollout policy — compatibility shim active for 90 days after merge. enable toggle `ALLOW_LEGACY_CONFIGS` in staging to test.
Dave: and add a short blurb to the onboarding docs + changelog so support doesn't get spammed.
Anya: will do. thanks all :thumbsup:
Mike: thanks — leaving this thread open for PR updates.
